title: How long is a C-string?
description:
A C-string is a row of characters ending in the invisible terminator `'\0'`. It does not know its own length: you find the end by walking along it.

Write `std::size_t lengthOf(const char* text)` that counts the characters before the terminator. Do not use `std::strlen` or `std::string`.
hints: Count with an index: `while (text[length] != '\0') ++length;`. When the loop stops, `length` is the number of characters before the terminator.
